messages:
incident-bot: :loud_sound: ALERT: serving-prod.error_burst (5m) > threshold at 1930012345
Maya P.: saw the spike on dashboards, paging @tom-sre and @erin-sre. taking a load of the first triage.
Tom L.: joining. initial glance: p95 latency and 5xx both jump correlated to a deploy event ~8m ago. deploy-bot, can you confirm recent model rollout?
deploy-bot: deployment: model=v3.8.2 image=redwood/model-server:3.8.2 started at 1930012300 by ci/cd pipeline. rollout strategy: gradual 20% steps.
Erin S.: thanks. I'm going to pause the rollout at 50% traffic and hold. can someone mute the noisy alerting group for the duration while we stabilize?
Maya P.: Pausing rollout via router: `routerctl pause-rollout --id deploy-1930012300`
Tom L.: muting per-model alerts for v3.8.* for 30m to avoid cascading pages: `alertsctl silence --match 'model=v3.8.*' --for 30m --reason "investigating deploy"`
Carol R.: observed increased kv_cache_evictions and a new pattern in sequence-length distribution after v3.8.2 goes live — higher tail for long-context requests. might be stressing cache and causing retries which surface as 5xx.
Maya P.: customer-impact check: current customer-affects stream shows 5 customers with increased errors, two with retries suppressed by SDKs. CS notified.
Tom L.: mitigation plan: 1) hold rollout (done) 2) scale serving pool +1 shard to increase cache capacity 3) revert model to v3.7.9 if errors keep >8% for 5m.
Erin S.: scaling pool now: `infractl scale serving-pool prod-gpu +1 --reason rollout-stability`
Grafana-bot: scaled 1 GPU shard at 1930012380. autoscaling event logged.
Tom L.: after scale, error rate trending down to 4.6% but p95 still elevated. Will let it run 10m then consider revert.
Maya P.: handoff note: I'll stay primary for the next 40m. Erin, you be backup. Tom, add runbook link to incident thread.
Tom L.: creating incident ticket and adding runbook excerpt. runbook step to add: validate kv_cache hit_rate and eviction_rate per model and sequence-length bucket.
Carol R.: for post-incident dashboard work: propose a dedicated Grafana retrospective dashboard called "model-rollforward-retro" with panels:
- golden signals per-model (rps, error %, p50/p95/p99)
- kv-cache: hit_rate, eviction_rate, memory_used_bytes
- sequence-length heatmap (requests by sequence length bucket)
- GPU shard utilization + pod OOMs
- route policy events & deploy annotations row with links to commit + CI run
- small table for affected customers and ticket links
Include links on panels to jump to Loki (logs) and Tempo (traces) filtered by `model` and `request_id`.
Tom L.: sketching PromQLs for the panels:```
# errors % by model (min reqs filter)
(sum(increase(serving_requests_errors_total{env="prod"}[10m])) by (model) / sum(increase(serving_requests_total{env="prod"}[10m])) by (model)) * 100

# p95 latency by model
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(serving_request_duration_seconds_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le, model))

# kv cache eviction rate
sum(rate(kv_cache_evictions_total{env="prod"}[5m])) by (model)
```
Erin S.: for alert tuning I want to avoid low-volume noise during A/B tests. proposal: require a minimum recent request volume in alert expr and use a 10m window:```
alert: ModelElevatedErrors
expr: (sum(increase(serving_requests_total{env="prod",model=~".+"}[10m])) by (model) > 250) and
(sum(increase(serving_requests_errors_total{env="prod",model=~".+"}[10m])) by (model) / sum(increase(serving_requests_total{env="prod",model=~".+"}[10m])) by (model)) > 0.06
for: 10m
labels: { severity: warning }
```
Maya P.: and then escalate to page SRE/ops if error% > 15% for 5m or if `affected_customers_count > 3`. add a label customer_impact=true for those rules.
Carol R.: dashboard UX: add drilldown links on panel titles to prefilled queries for Loki and Tempo. also add a template variable `$model` at the top so reviewers can quickly switch context. a heatmap for sequence-length vs error rate would help pinpoint when long contexts trigger evictions.
Tom L.: I'll create a PR to infra/dashboards/retrospectives/model-rollforward-retro.json with initial panels and a note to ingest `router_deploy_events` into the annotations datasource.
Erin S.: action items: (1) alert rule change with min-volume and longer for: (2) create model-rollforward-retro dashboard with golden signals + heatmap + annotations (3) add runbook validation step for kv-cache before/after rollouts (4) add automated rollback policy: if model error% > 12% for 7m, auto-shift traffic to previous stable variant. assign owners in ticket.
Maya P.: filing follow-ups in the incident ticket now and assigning Carol for the dashboard, Tom for alert rule, Erin for rollback policy.
Tom L.: handoff: I'll be on watch for 30m then hand to Erin. leaving a concise summary in #incidents.
Erin S.: thanks all. marking pager resolved (no longer paging) but keeping incident OPEN for postmortem work. will post a retro invite. :spiral_calendar:
